title: For our outdoor bar
text: For our outdoor bar. No more carting tools back and forth - this will take care of needs at the bar on the deck.  Everything we need for mixed drinks - one surprise is the “zester”, which is great for adding  a peel, or even some zest for fruity drinks.  Wish the quality of the tools were better - looks kinda cheap - we like that zester and the muddler, though.

product_metadata.title: Rabbit Align 5 Piece Home Bar Tool Set with Caddy (Stainless Steel/Black)
features: This luxurious 5 piece barware set features a jigger, bottle opener, cocktail strainer, muddler, and citrus zester
Includes everything you need to start making your favorite cocktails at home, perfect for hosting parties and other special events
Durable stainless steel working ends are complemented by ergonomic black handles for superior comfort and efficiency
Bar tools stand upright in the included caddy for easy, compact storage on a countertop or bar cart
Matte black and stainless steel accents add classic style and modern functionality to your home bar
description: Planning a Friday movie night in or a late-night taco and margarita party with friends? Whatever the occasion, Rabbit's 5 piece bar tool set includes all the cocktail essentials you need to start crafting custom drinks in the comfort of your own home. This bar kit comes with a jigger, bottle opener, cocktail strainer, muddler, and citrus zester. Matte black handles and stainless steel working ends add equal doses of class, comfort, and durability. Customize your drinks with unique flavors and twists using the citrus zester and muddler, or make your cocktail twice as strong with the stainless steel jigger. After your signature drink is complete, hand wash and place your bar tools upright in the included tool caddy. Not only does this barware set look great on a bar cart or countertop, but its dual style and functionality will have you looking - and feeling - like a professional bartender in no time.
